How it works

Four simple steps, all from your sofa.

You can complete your entire order by email or WhatsApp, from your home or office.

Why are we cheaper?Our showroom is exclusively online, so we don’t pay high rent for a physical showroom.

  1. Measure

    Choose your blinds on our website showroom, then measure your windows or doors.

    Measure it yourselfTake your own measurements and get an extra 10% discount.
    We measure for youCash call-out fee from R300 (by distance from Pinetown), refunded when you place your order.

  2. Quote

    Send your measurements and requirements by the quote form, email or WhatsApp. You’ll receive a free quote by email within 3 hours.

  3. Deposit

    Accept the quote, it becomes an official order, and pay your deposit.

  4. Verify & install

    Once your deposit is in, a representative visits to verify your measurements (Durban and surrounding areas). Your blinds are then delivered to your doorstep, or fitted at your home or office.

Cleaning & repairs

Tired blinds? We clean and repair them.

We clean and repair Vertical, Venetian and Roller blinds in Durban and the surrounding areas. Bring them to us, or we can remove and rehang them for you. The easiest way to get a repair quote is to send a photo on WhatsApp with your details and what’s wrong.

Cleaning: 25 & 35mm aluminium Venetians and roller blinds
from R150
Cleaning: 50mm aluminium, imitation wood or basswood Venetians
from R200
Cleaning: vertical blades, drops under 1.5m
R7 each
Pick-up and rehang, within 60km of Pinetown
R400

Cleaning prices are per blind, by width. Add 10% if the drop is over 2m. Cleaning cannot be done on site, but some repairs can.

About us

Since1995

Blind Specialist started in 1995 with cleaning and repairing blinds, then grew into a thriving business as an agent for top manufacturers, selling custom-made new blinds. A family enterprise, built on honesty, exceptional service and unbeatable prices.

3

year carry-in guarantee

On your blinds, with all blinds sold falling under the manufacturers’ full guarantees, administered by us.

Happy customers

We have done blinds for fine companies, including the University of Zululand and Air Products Pinetown, and you are welcome to phone them for a reference.

Double quality check

Every blind undergoes a double quality check before it reaches you.

Direct from the factory

As authorised agents for multiple manufacturers, we deliver the finest blinds from the factory to any location in South Africa.

Honest terms

Because all our blinds are custom-made, we don’t accept returns, so please measure with care.
